# Yozakura

> Yozakura (夜桜) is a Wayland desktop shell (bar, notch/dynamic island, dock, launcher, dashboard, AI center, lock screen) built with Quickshell/QML and a Go backend. Every setting is declared in a machine-readable catalog and can be read, searched, validated and changed from the `yozakura` CLI or its built-in MCP server; changes hot-apply.

Start with docs/ai-guide.md. Key facts:

- Config: one JSON file per domain in ~/.config/yozakura/config/<domain>.json (domains: ai bar compositor desktop dock general lockscreen notch overview performance prefix system theme voice weather workspaces). Keys are <domain>.<dotted.path>, e.g. bar.position, bar.layout.style, theme.srBg.opacity.
- Catalog: assets/schema/yozakura.schema.json (JSON Schema 2020-12, one file per domain too) with type, default, title, description, enum, range and settings page of every key. Generated by `make schema` from config/defaults/*.js, config/meta/*.js and modules/settings/schema/*.js.
- CLI: `yozakura config list|get|set|toggle|describe|reset|search|schema|path`, `yozakura preset list|apply|save|update|diff|show|aspects|mix|duplicate|rename|delete|restore|trash|set-info|export|import|try|edit|active`, `yozakura completion bash|zsh|fish`, `yozakura run <ui command>`, `yozakura cmd list|<command> [arg]` (launcher quick commands), `yozakura onboarding`.
- MCP: `yozakura mcp` (stdio). Tools: config_search, config_schema, config_describe, config_get, config_set, presets_list, preset_apply, preset_save, preset_diff, preset_show, preset_mix, preset_duplicate, preset_rename, preset_delete, shell_commands, shell_command, plus windows/workspaces, wallpaper, notifications, clipboard, screenshot, media, volume, dnd.
- Rules for agents: search/describe before set, never guess keys, save a preset backup before sweeping changes, report old -> new values.

## Docs

- [AI guide](docs/ai-guide.md): organisation, CLI and MCP reference, 40+ recipes, code map, how to extend, definition of done
- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): conventions, anti-patterns, quality gate (`make check`)
- [Settings window](modules/settings/AGENTS.md): declaring a setting (schema entries, translations)
- [Config system](config/AGENTS.md): defaults, Config.qml, validator
- [Bar](modules/bar/AGENTS.md), [Notch panels](modules/widgets/defaultview/panels/AGENTS.md), [Desktop and clock styles](modules/desktop/AGENTS.md), [Live activities](modules/services/activities/AGENTS.md)
- [Dynamic island](docs/dynamic-island.md), [Special workspaces](docs/special-workspaces.md), [Mods](docs/mods/README.md)
